additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386798-DC/Si-D/UA-[MP / R9 170002580] Rollback to v4.0.11 CRM:01811000409
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Ievgen,
Apologies for the late feedback. I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0386798
, which was opened for downgrade request of charger
YKGwB5
from FW v5.0.21 to v4.0.11.
As a matter of fact, the charger is currently running on FW v4.0.11, whilst FW v5.0.21 it is just rolled out on SCB. The removal of FW from SCB is an action that we in the ES team cannot perform, so I was waiting for R&D support.
In the meanwhile, I got to know that, for the
upcoming release of FW v6.0.1 (planned for CW2 of 2025)
, there will be a mandatory step to update the chargers running in v4.0.11 first to v5.0.X and then to v6.0.1. The reason is because v6.0.1 will be a major release, and major steps cannot be skipped, due to rollout firmware strategy and compatibility. Therefore, it will be necessary to follow the sequence
FWv4.0.11 > FWv5.0.X > FWv6.0.1.
Therefore, my suggestion is to keep the FW v5.0.21 rolled out to the charger. When FW6.0.1 will be released and you will update the charger, FW5.0.21 will be already rolled out to the charger and ready to be updated.
If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to me. I will proceed to close this ticket as there's no pending action required.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
